verdict.rationale: Document extraction is a fair question for a web crawler aimed at LLM ingestion, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Crawl4AI parsing PDF, Word, Excel, or PowerPoint files. The closest item is processing raw HTML or local files via `file://`, which is neither document-format parsing nor extraction from remotely hosted files.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract text content from PDFs, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files without hosting them myself
